_meta.do_not_edit: Edit the source MD file; CI regenerates this dist file.

parts.name: Container
parts.description: bounded surface that scopes the data presentation (card, tile, table, row, badge)

parts.name: Header (optional)
parts.description: title plus optional actions, metadata, or filters; carried by tables, cards, accordions

parts.name: Body content
parts.description: the rendered data: text, numbers, charts, rows, list items, avatar imagery

parts.name: Footer (optional)
parts.description: supplementary actions, totals, pagination, or metadata

parts.name: State indicator (optional)
parts.description: sort caret, selected check, expanded chevron, badge severity, loading shimmer

patterns.note: hover, selected, and expanded state changes use the shared interaction-motion timing; transitions affect background, border, and indicator position, not layout
expand/collapse uses height transition with easing from motion foundations; content fades in after the container reaches target height

patterns.pattern: Staggered Entrance — Lists, Table Rows, Search Cards
patterns.note: long lists and grids reveal items with a short stagger to convey order; total duration capped to avoid perceived lag

requirements.title: Semantic structure
requirements.body: use `<table>` for tabular data, `<ul>`/`<ol>` for lists, `<h2>`–`<h4>` for card titles; do not collapse semantics into generic divs

requirements.title: Keyboard navigation in interactive cells
requirements.body: actionable cells (links, buttons, checkboxes) are reachable in DOM order; data-grid patterns follow the WAI-ARIA grid keyboard model when used

requirements.title: Sortable column announcements
requirements.body: sortable headers expose `aria-sort="ascending"`, `"descending"`, or `"none"`; sort change is announced via a live region

requirements.title: Expand/collapse announcements
requirements.body: accordion triggers expose `aria-expanded`; the controlled region is referenced via `aria-controls`

requirements.title: Focus management in expandable content
requirements.body: expanding does not move focus unexpectedly; collapsing returns focus to the trigger if it would otherwise be lost

requirements.title: Data table headers
requirements.body: every data column has a `<th scope="col">`; row headers use `scope="row"`; complex tables use `headers`/`id` association
